items.author: Pratik Gupta (AVP, Deutsche Bank), Oct 25
items.summary: He argues Databricks dashboards win when the data already lives in the lakehouse, while Tableau still wins on advanced visuals, many data sources, and drag-and-drop for analysts who don't write SQL. He links a Medium write-up about a team that tried to replace Tableau and kept it.

items.author: Faizaan Fareed (agentic BI consultant), Oct 25
items.summary: One Power BI report with 80 custom chart types, including Sankey, chord, sunburst, streamgraph, ridgeline and beeswarm. Each one is a custom visual packaged in PBIP, and he offers this as a service.

items.author: Mehdi J. Maasoumy (Databricks), Oct 22
items.summary: A weekly executive agent on Databricks Genie One that reads email, Slack, docs and meeting transcripts, checks each project's status, and returns a ranked list with draft replies. He says it cut about 80 person-hours a week to 1 to 2 hours across 50+ projects.

items.author: Harnham
items.summary: Director of Enterprise Data — Harnham — Remote US (listed under Texas) — posted about Oct 23 — $250K to $300K plus a 20% bonus — Leads about 60 data engineers. Needs deep Snowflake, ELT, streaming and AI-ready data products. Engineering-heavy.
